SRC-323:R001.text: A substantial handoff is evaluated against the current implementation and canonical history BEFORE redundant Work is created.

SRC-323:R002.text: Already-satisfied clauses are supported by real current evidence, never by semantic similarity or an agent narrative.

SRC-323:R003.text: Missing, defective or unverified clauses remain actionable and are not swallowed by a duplicate verdict.

SRC-323:R004.text: Source and Work reach a consistent terminal state when the request is fully satisfied.

SRC-323:R005.text: Work that already owns a Source can be terminally superseded, so attached receipts cannot create a permanent supersession/retirement cycle.

SRC-323:R006.text: A genuine repeat request from the operator stays actionable and is never silently discarded as a duplicate.

SRC-323:R007.text: Automatic equivalence analysis fabricates no operator authority and bypasses no publication gate.

SRC-323:R008.text: Unrelated independent authorized Work resumes automatically after a proven no-op request.
